capability_needs.summary: GitHub content gather through a host/runtime-provided capability.
capability_needs.when: when gather needs GitHub repository or PR access beyond public dev tooling

capability_needs.summary: Google Workspace gather through a host/runtime-provided (host-mediated) capability.
capability_needs.when: when gather needs Docs, Drive, Sheets, or Slides access and the host provides the capability

capability_needs.summary: Browser-mediated public source gather through the external `agent-browser` runtime.
capability_needs.when: when gather has a public URL or stable UI path and an official API/export route is unavailable or insufficient

notes: gather is public-source only. Credentialed org data (Slack, Notion, private Drive) is out of scope and belongs to the consuming runtime's own capability/connector surface, not a charness gather capability binding.
